notes: Strip b: x 2800-4820, full height, plus overlap x 2500-5120. Pedretti Avenue: printed 'AVE.' on the segment between 8th and Carnation (x~2972, y~300-450) and 'PEDRETTI' on the south segment (x~2950, y~2380-2650); one continuous street from 8th to Foley. It is 50 ft (block lines ~2930-3002, '50'' printed at (2982,1320)) from 8th to y~1347, then 30 ft ('30' printed at (2950,1370) and (2943,2780); block lines ~2927-2975) south to Foley. The solid/dashed lines inside it are the 12" sewer and water pipe. Amelia Avenue (west) and Carnation Avenue (east) are one line of street that changes name at Pedretti; Carnation centre drifts from y~951 at Pedretti to ~961 at Hermosa. Hermosa Street printed 'HERMOSA ST.', 50' printed at its north end; 50 also printed at its south end by Carnation. W. 8th Street printed 'W. EIGHTH' (west of the strip) and 'STREET' (east of it); no width printed in this strip; its north line is the plate's top neat line; the double line at y~105-110 and dashed line at ~85 are pipes/sewer. Foley Road runs along the bottom: north line ~2805-2810 east of Pedretti, rising from ~2824 at x 2600 to ~2805 at Pedretti on the west; its south line is close to the plate's bottom edge (~2870-2893); 'CITY LIMITS' is printed along it east of x~4400. NOT recorded as a street: 'GREEN HILL PL. PRIVATE' (dashed private lane leaving Pedretti's east side at about (2954,2344) and running ESE to a rounded end at about (3570,2490)) - a private lane, excluded per the rules; add it if private places are wanted. Not streets: the dashed 24"/36"/42" sewer lines crossing the open ground, the coloured boundary bands (yellow along Pedretti's west side, orange/blue along Amelia and Doll, pink band at x~4950 south of 8th), and owner/estate lettering (SIMON ...DEHR EST., ...TRAUTH..., H. F. LACKMAN, J. J. NEWMAN, CHAS. PEDRETTI, JOHN J. SCHIFF ET. AL., GEO. VAUGHN'S ESTATE, B. C. ROTH). No other streets cross the strip: blocks between Pedretti and Hermosa (8th to Carnation and Carnation south) and everything south of Carnation/Doll to Foley is open ground. The avenue at x~2333 (west of the overlap) was not picked.
